description: Peer correlation values equal to 0.149 are counted (at least 0.149).

c.request: Using 0.149 as the cutoff, how many advanced behaviour records have high peer correlation (`peercorr`)? Give a single count. Peer correlation values equal to 0.149 are counted (at least 0.149).
c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149

b.request: Count the advanced behaviour records whose peer correlation (`peercorr`) is greater than or equal to 0.149, treating "high" as at least the 0.149 cutoff, and return a single count.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_peercorr_count FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149
b.raw: Count the advanced behaviour records whose peer correlation (`peercorr`) is greater than or equal to 0.149, treating "high" as at least the 0.149 cutoff, and return a single count.

a.request: How many advanced behaviour records have a peer correlation (`peercorr`) of at least 0.149?
